instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/history.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 reviewer, verbatim: "per-page undo doesn't work: an edit on page 2 never reaches page 2's undo stack, and the store raises \"ElementsDelta invariant broken for element rect2\"; History.record in packages/excalidraw/history.ts filters the previous snapshot to the active page, which breaks how the store computes the change (AC-4)." Reproduction: render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />), add rect1 via API.updateScene with CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY, act(() => h.app.addPage()), add rect2 the same way -> h.history.undoStackByPage is [["page-1",1],["<page2>",0]], rect2.pageId is the page-2 id, and the store logs `ElementsDelta invariant broken for element "rect2"`. Fix: remove the active-page filtering of the store snapshot / elements in History (perform around lines 229-245, and any in record): the store's snapshot always holds ALL pages' elements (App.tsx is changed in this round to commit scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() to the store), so every recorded StoreDelta contains only the elements actually changed, and it is pushed onto the active page's undo stack; undo/redo apply the popped delta to the all-pages elements map without filtering. Result: undo on page 2 reverts rect2 and never touches page 1; switching pages keeps each page's stacks.

instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. (A) Per-page undo (AC-4), paired with the history.ts fix in this round: the store must see all pages' elements, else an element on the other page looks removed and the store raises `ElementsDelta invariant broken for element "rect2"`. Change every `this.store.commit(...)` (lines ~2806 and ~4685) and any other elements map given to the store/history (history.undo/redo calls, scheduleMicroAction around page switches) to use `this.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted()` instead of the active-page `getElementsMapIncludingDeleted()`, and apply the elements history returns with replaceAllElements(..., { allPages: true }) when they span pages. (B) Security finding (Low), verbatim location: `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx:2804` - `pageViewports[pageId]` is indexed by an unvalidated page id, so `__proto__`, `constructor` or `toString` resolve to Object.prototype properties. Read it only when `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(pageViewports, pageId)`, and never write a page id that is `__proto__`, `constructor` or `prototype`.
